newsitem.title: USA: US to sell $12 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills April 21.
newsitem.headline: US to sell $12 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills April 21.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $12 billion of three- and six-month bills on April 21 to pay down $6.225 billion as a total of $18.220 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on April 24. The three-month bills mature on July 24 and the six-month bills mature on October 23.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127942S2 and for the six-month bills is 9127945R1.
